# Ariful Islam — Product Designer & Design Engineer

Ariful Islam is a product designer and design engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He focuses on enterprise SaaS, AI-enabled workflows, human-first UX, design systems, and production-ready front-end experiences.
